player_position.why: The player's world position [x, y, z], three.js frame (y up). Changes when the player moves, jumps, falls or is carried by a platform or vehicle.

player_velocity.why: The player's physics linear velocity [x, y, z]. y rises on a jump and falls under gravity.

grounded.why: Whether the character controller reports the player standing on ground.

player_state.why: The player's movement state machine state: idle, move, jump, air, airJump, interact, crouch, carry, grab, land, climb or rope.

carrying.why: Whether the player is holding a grabbable object.

in_vehicle.why: Whether the player is driving a vehicle (the car or the drone).

hearts.why: The player's current health in hearts. Hazards and falls lower it; it resets on respawn.

coins_collected.why: Coins collected in the current run.

coins_remaining.why: Coins still to collect in the current run.
